purpose: MySQL与PostgreSQL统一Adapter Suite共享语句集（BE-B4-ADAPTER验收门禁：同一Suite跑两种引擎）。占位符由测试注入；cancel_select按引擎选择。

statements.create_items: CREATE TABLE items (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, note VARCHAR(64) NULL, secret_note VARCHAR(64) NULL)
statements.insert_item: INSERT INTO items (id, name, note, secret_note) VALUES ({id}, '{name}', '{note}', '{secret}')
statements.select_items: SELECT id, name, note, secret_note FROM items ORDER BY id
statements.explain_select: SELECT id, name FROM items WHERE id = {id}
statements.explain_update: UPDATE items SET name = 'EXPLAIN_MUST_NOT_EXECUTE' WHERE id = {id}
statements.dml_insert: INSERT INTO items (id, name, note, secret_note) VALUES ({id}, '{name}', NULL, NULL)
statements.dml_update: UPDATE items SET note = 'tx-note' WHERE id = {id}
statements.dml_unique_conflict: INSERT INTO items (id, name, note, secret_note) VALUES ({id}, 'dup', NULL, NULL)
statements.ddl_create_ok: CREATE TABLE suite_ddl_ok (id INT PRIMARY KEY)
statements.ddl_create_conflict: CREATE TABLE items (id INT PRIMARY KEY)
statements.ddl_create_third: CREATE TABLE suite_ddl_third (id INT PRIMARY KEY)
